# Duo

## Single sign-on (SAML 2.0)

In the portal, choose **Duo** under Enterprise SSO and **Start with Duo**. Then, in Duo:

1. In the Duo Admin Panel, go to Applications → Application Catalog, find Generic SAML Service Provider (SSO), and click Add.
2. Under User access, choose the groups who may sign in.
3. In Service Provider, enter the Entity ID and Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL below — or choose Metadata XML URL under Metadata Discovery, enter ours and click Populate.
4. In SAML Response, set NameID attribute to &lt;Email Address&gt;.
5. Save, then copy the Metadata URL from the Metadata section.

### The values the portal shows

| Duo field | Value |
|---|---|
| Metadata XML URL (Service Provider → Metadata Discovery), optional | The portal's SP metadata URL (`https://…/sso/saml/…/metadata`) |
| Entity ID (Service Provider) | The portal's entity ID (`https://…/sso/saml/…`) |
| Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL (Service Provider) | The portal's ACS URL (`https://…/sso/saml/…/acs`) |
| Single Logout URL (Service Provider), optional | The portal's Single Logout URL (`https://…/sso/saml/…/slo`) |
| Service Provider Login URL (Service Provider), optional | The portal's sign-in URL (`https://…/sso/saml/…/login`) |
| NameID attribute (SAML Response) | `<Email Address>` |

### What to bring back

Copy **Metadata URL** — the URL, or the XML — and paste it into the portal's **Metadata URL or XML**. Prefer the URL.

The assertion must be signed, and must carry the person's email address as an attribute or as a NameID in the `emailAddress` format. See [Any SAML 2.0 provider](generic-saml.md) for the details.

Duo's own guide: <https://duo.com/docs/sso-generic>.

Then verify your domain and turn single sign-on on in the portal: [Enterprise SSO](../sso.md).

## Directory Sync (SCIM)

In the portal, choose **Duo** under Directory sync and **Create directory**; copy the bearer token now, it is shown once. Then, in Duo:

1. Open the application under Applications → Applications and select the Provisioning tab.
2. Under Authentication, choose Bearer Token and enter the Base URL and Token below.
3. Click Connect to application and wait for it to succeed.
4. Review the attribute mappings and choose the groups to provision.
5. Click Save and enable.

### The values the portal shows

| Duo field | Value |
|---|---|
| Authentication (Provisioning) | `Bearer Token` |
| Base URL (Provisioning) | The portal's SCIM base URL (`https://…/scim/v2`) |
| Token (Provisioning) | The bearer token the portal shows once |

Duo's own guide: <https://duo.com/docs/automated-provisioning>.
